title: Check-In Payment Allowance — Insured Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) Payoffs
content:
Payments a patient made in person at a Riverbend registration or cashier desk (point-of-service payments) on an insured Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) account raise the insured payoff discount percent when the account is paid off in full.

**Clause.** The account's point-of-service payments are totalled: a total of at least 250.00 USD adds 1.5 percentage points to the insured payoff discount percent, a total above 0.00 but below 250.00 adds 0.75 percentage points, and no such payment adds none.

| Point-of-service payments on the account | Percentage points added |
|---|---|
| at least 250.00 | 1.5 |
| above 0.00, below 250.00 | 0.75 |
| none | none |

## Points of judgement (hypothetical payments)

- Two point-of-service payments of 100.00 and 150.00 total 250.00: 1.5 points.
- One point-of-service payment of 249.99: 0.75 points.
- Payments by portal card, phone card, bank draft or mailed check are not point-of-service payments and do not enter the total.
